name: Kotobuki Ryuu
source:
A newly transferred student who takes the entire school by storm. He immediately overthrows Kazuya’s position as the most influential yet popular student in school. Compared to Kazuya, Ryuu can do anything slightly better. He is not a dimwit like Kazuya, and he is also charming. Kazuya isn’t bothered by Ryuu’s existence or even jealous because all the attention is going to him. One thing Kazuya cannot accept about Ryuu is that Kazuya doesn’t remember that Risu had an older brother. Ryuu knows everything about Risu and decides to help Risu regain all her memories together with Kazuya, but what is his purpose?

[Taken from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/63024782/la-memoire-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
